provenance.prompt:
Match Marco Vellum using the attached portrait and gameplay atlas: compact athletic adult human MAN, medium-light olive skin, strong angular clean-shaven face, short thick black hair with slight wave; no mustache, no beard, no long hair. Black Blackthorn Court Kings jersey and shorts with crimson piping and white trim, black wristbands, black high-top shoes. Keep this exact identity and uniform in all six poses.

Create six distinct complete full-body poses, strict row-major three columns by two rows on transparent RGBA 1536x1024. Each figure about 65% of its 512x512 cell height, centered with wide gutters and safe cell margins. Nothing may cross a cell boundary. Crisp outlined 1990s arcade pixel art. No background, court, floor, shadow, hoop, text, other athletes, basketball or props.

Right-facing chest pass sequence: 0 ready balanced, hands empty; 1 steps forward and gathers invisible ball around waist; 2 brings both empty hands to chest, elbows bent; 3 rotates torso and drives both hands forward toward image-right; 4 arms extend fully in two-hand pass, palms/fingers open and empty; 5 follows through and returns balanced. No basketball at any point; Marco's ball is rendered by his own independent runtime track.

All six figures are complete, distinct and anatomically natural, with two arms/hands, two legs/shoes. Keep Marco clean-shaven and short-haired in every cell. True alpha-zero background and gutters, no haze/checkerboard. Return only the sheet.

review.notes: Six frames show the correct adult clean-shaven Marco, short wavy black hair, olive skin and black/crimson uniform. Chest-pass motion is readable and fits the 3x2 grid. Initial source had a dark ball-like object in the waist gather; localized image edit reconstructed empty hands, and cleanup isolated the athlete. Final atlas has no ball.

ballTrack.art: no ball in atlas; independent Marco-specific runtime path

cleanup.method: Localized image edit removes the only generated ball-like object; per-cell largest alpha>=32 athlete component plus 2px antialias fringe clears background haze; action6 packer verifies six full pose components.

generationHistory.reason: Correct Marco identity and clear chest-pass; pose 1 had a dark ball-like object, removed in localized edit.
Removed object from pose 1; retained all other poses and Marco identity.
